ns2:course.label: Advanced Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Analytical, experimental, or computational studies in one or more areas of theoretical and applied mechanics, including solid mechanics, behavior of materials, fluid mechanics, dynamics, applied mathematics, and computational science and engineering. (Summer session, 1 to 4 hours). May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
